description:
This isn'yt just any old Kinder Bueno Ice Cream, this is the best Kinder Bueno ice cream you're going to eat!
It's creamy, hazelnutty, has wonderful textures, did I say creamy...... 🤔😉

Yes, there is a few parts to this but MY WORD it is good. Even if you just make the ice cream and swirl in the Hazelnut Cream, you are going to be in ice cream heaven, I promise. 

So what you'll need is:
Milk 830g 
Cream 740g
Sugar 220g
Corn syrup 60g
SMP 120g
Stabilizer 3.5g (if using)
5g Hazelnut Extract

Hazelnut Butter:
100g Hazelnuts (roasted and skins removed)
175g White Chocolate (melted)

Hazelnut Cream:
130g White Chocolate (melted)
5g Hazelnut Extract
5g Corn Syrup (or dextrose/corn sugar)

Milk Chocolate Straciatella:
100g Milk Chocolate
10g Refined Coconut Oil (of any unflavored oil)

If I were to change anything in this recipe, I would change the corn syrup in the hazelnut cream to dextrose (corn sugar) but apart from that its great.
